thread:
maya: heads up — a customer opened a ticket, their Token Cost dashboard shows $0 for some orgs and NaN for a couple. Screenshot attached: https://redwood.link/snap1 :eyes:

tony: which orgs/ids? whole org or subaccount level? any recent deploys to billing pipelines?

maya: orgs: org_82f, org_9b3 (both EU region). Happened for hourly buckets around 02:00 UTC. Some rows are literal NaN in the UI, others $0. Other orgs look normal. No deploy note in #eng-releases for billing in that window.

natasha: thanks — can you paste a sample row payload from the hourly aggregator? suspecting a pricing join miss where price columns became null after the pricing schema change. If you can run a quick query:
```sql
select org_id, bucket_ts, usage_tokens, pricing_key, pricing.price_per_token, pricing.price_per_token_v2
from hourly_token_agg h
left join pricing_map pricing on h.pricing_key = pricing.key
where org_id in ('org_82f','org_9b3') and bucket_ts >= '2026-03-02T01:00:00Z';
```

liam: FYI I pushed a schema change at 01:50 that added price_per_token_v2. I also ran a small migration that backfilled v2 for some customers but skipped a few legacy keys. If the aggregator expects price_per_token and pricing_map now only has v2 for many keys, left join could yield nulls.

metrics-bot: alert: hourly-aggregator job failed and retried at 2026-03-02T02:03:17Z — error=NullPointerException at Aggregator.java:142; fallback path wrote zero-unit-cost rows for 37 buckets.

tony: that matches. The retry path is currently set to write a zero price if join yields null to avoid blocking downstream. Bad tradeoff here. Plan: patch aggregator to coalesce price to most recent non-null price (look up last_known_price table) instead of writing zero; then run a backfill for affected buckets.

natasha: quick patch ready — change the pricing resolution SQL to:
```sql
coalesce(pricing.price_per_token, pricing.price_per_token_v2, last_known.price_per_token, 0::numeric) as unit_price
```
and ensure we treat text 'NaN' as null:
```sql
nullif(pricing.price_per_token::text, 'NaN')::numeric
```
I'll open a canary PR to eng-runtime.

liam: starting backfill for org_82f, org_9b3 now (job: billing-backfill-20260302). ETA ~45m. Will mark impacted invoices as pending until we have corrected values.

maya: please ping when complete so I can update the customer. Also want a short public blurb for status page if ETA extends.

tony: will add a postmortem entry and change retry behavior to fail loud instead of writing zeros.

liam: backfill progress: 12/37 buckets done, no further NaNs created.

maya: copying support ticket update: "We're investigating a metrics aggregation issue causing temporary $0/NaN values in the Token Cost dashboard for a subset of orgs. Engineering has identified a pricing schema mismatch and is running a backfill; expected resolution within ~45m. We'll follow up with corrected billing numbers."

maya: thanks all — tagging @natasha @tony @liam for follow-up. :thumbsup:
